title: Serpent Queen with Dagger
description: A regal dark-haired woman wearing an ornate golden spiked crown and black-and-gold scaled armor sits upon a throne. She holds a golden dagger that pierces the open mouth of a massive purple serpent with black and gold spots, blood dripping from the wound as the snake coils around her body.
prompt: A regal dark-haired woman with golden spiked crown and black scaled armor sits on a dark throne, plunging a golden dagger into the open mouth of a giant purple serpent with black and gold spots. The snake coils around her body and throne, blood dripping from its jaws. Dramatic golden light rays from above, dark purple background with floating particles, intense and menacing atmosphere, detailed scales and metallic textures
